name: flywheel-ship-gate
description: Per-STEP execution gate for content flywheels. campaign-preflight gates the PLAN (is every surface enumerated); this gates EXECUTION (did every in-scope surface actually ship, with a recorded URL that resolves). BLOCKS any 'campaign complete' claim while a surface is pending, URL-less, or dead.

enforcement.no_python_harness_note: P4 Three-Layer Architecture: the invariant layer is TypeScript via Bun. HOW.py is banned. An earlier proposal shipped this rule as HOW.py + check.py; that form was rejected.

input.target: absolute path to the campaign master markdown
input.skip_http: true to skip live URL checks (default false)

single_source_of_truth.why: signal-pollution invariant — the same rule must never run from both cyborg/rules/ and an installed plugin. Two enforcement paths can disagree, and fixing one silently leaves the other wrong.

cadence: invoked before declaring any campaign complete; by social-distribution-engine at ship time
litmus: For every in-scope surface: terminal status AND a URL AND the URL resolves? Any no means the campaign is not complete.
origin: 2026-08-16 campaign 12: a flywheel was declared finished while a requested deliverable had never shipped and surface statuses still read TODO for surfaces that were live. campaign-completeness passed, because the PLAN was complete.
